Russian Envoy Dmitriev Heads to US for Talks With Witkoff, Kushner
items.description: Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev is heading to New York for talks with Trump administration officials as Ukraine pushes an unconditional ceasefire backed by 50 countries. Moscow has yet to respond, while US-Russia contacts continue over the war and potential peace talks

items.title: Why have some nations developed while others struggle?
items.description: At UNGA, Iran, Syria and Kenya have highlighted how war and injustice have skewed global development.

items.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
items.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

items.title: Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region
items.description: Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

items.title: Zelensky accuses Putin of using third-country fighters in Russia's war against Ukraine
items.description: The longer the Russian president 'is able to wage war, the more evil he will leave behind in this world' said the Ukrainian president at the United Nations on Wednesday.

items.title: Zelensky, 'Putin deve essere fermato, le sanzioni ci rafforzano'
Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.

items.title: Famine threatens the Ukrainian town of Oleshky in the southern Kherson region as Russia delays creating a humanitarian evacuation corridor
items.description: Food supplies to the town of Oleshky in the occupied part of the southern Kherson region have been cut off since May. Efforts by Kyiv to negotiate the evacuation of civilians with Moscow have been largely unsuccessful.

items.title: Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire
items.description: US President Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly on September 22. Trump said he believes that both Ukraine and Russia "want to see the war end," and raised the possibility of meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the G20 summit in December…

items.title: At UN, Trump again threatens Iran, but suggests end of war is near
items.description: President Trump used his speech at the United Nations to say he believed the Iran war was coming to a resolution “one way or the other.”

items.title: New U.S. Sanctions Will Harm Ukraine Peace Talks and Bilateral Ties, Kremlin Says
items.description: Without criticizing Donald Trump directly, Russian officials said the latest measures would only further strain relations.
